csv_caveat: Official issue15024 reported a stale CSV export, but parent verified it was closed by15053. Do not claim CSV is currently stale without checking downloaded content. Audit content dates rather than trusting an HTTP Last-Modified header.
forecasting_caveat: The verified cases were selected because changes occurred. They cannot establish predictive accuracy or train a reliable product-change forecaster without comparable non-change products, known observation windows, sufficient events and time-separated validation.
